testcase.name: Scenario: Resize the docked model browser: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:717:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Resize the docked model browser ✔ Given a part is open in the MCAD Software with the model browser docked at the left ✔ And the browser tree and a shaded block are visible ✔ When the user drags the divider between the browser and viewport to the right ✔ Then the browser becomes wider and the viewport becomes narrower ✔ And the tree hierarchy remains visible ✔ And the block remains visible with the same apparent size and orientation ✔ When the user drags the divider back to the left ✔ Then the browser becomes narrower and the viewport becomes wider ✔ And the tree and block remain visible
